title: Checkpointing, incremental verification, and the projection snapshot
note: A checkpoint caches a verification RESULT. These mutations delete the checks that keep it from becoming a second source of truth: the anchor is re-hashed rather than trusted, an incremental report is forced to admit it is incremental, and a checkpoint that does not describe the log in front of it is refused rather than used.
